query: Let `f : ℂ → ℂ` be analytic on the closed ball `B(c, R)`, satisfy `f c ≠ 0`, and `‖f z‖ ≤ M` on the sphere `∂B(c, R)` for some `M ≥ 1`. For any `r` with `0 < |r| < |R|`: the sum (with multiplicity) of the orders of zeros of `f` in `B(c, r)` is at most `log(M / ‖f c‖) / log(R / r)`.
